metadata.case_name: LO SIU NING v. CHAN KAI HING AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Health care worker (at Yi Lok Adult Training Centre, Fu Hong Society)
plaintiff.education_level: 3 years full-time training in nursing care in Mainland (1979-1982)

source: The nerve conduction test on 7 December 2002 shown features suggestive of sacral plexus injury.

injuries.description: Crack fracture at distal one-third of the left clavicle
source: An X ray examination of the left clavicle shown suspected crack at distal one-third.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of acromial end of clavicle

injuries.description: Severe soft tissue crushed injury of back and pelvis
source: Dr. Tsoi also formed the view that the Plaintiff suffered from rather severe soft tissue crushed injury of her back and pelvis during the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Crushing injury of other or unspecified parts of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: Neurofibroma involving the right T12 exiting nerve root at the right T12/L1 intervetebral foraman
injuries.body_part: right T12 nerve root (T12/L1 intervertebral foramen)
source: MRI performed on 12 July 2004 shown a neurofibroma involving the right T12 exiting nerve root at the right T12/L1 intervetebral foraman.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: Right lower limb weakness (power of right ankle dorsiflexion, plantiflexion, extensor and flexor hallicis longus (EHL & FHL) were about 1/5; later improved to 3/5; power about 3/5 below knee on 30 November 2002)
Decrease in pinprick sensation over right lower limb especially at the L5/S1 dermatome
Problems in controlling the bowel opening and urination
Left shoulder pain and stiffness with reduced range of motion; residual inflammation and scarring of injured tissues around left shoulder
Unable to walk for 5 minutes; walked with mild limping when aided with a stick; more severe limping when walked unaided; could walk up to 30 minutes unaided (later report)

Post-traumatic stress disorder, anxiety, phobia towards vehicles, hyper-vigilance, flashbacks, vivid nightmares, hyper-arousal symptoms (palpitation, hand tremor, sweating); adjustment disorder; depression (including suicidal idea during one admission)
Loss of sexual interest and back pain during sexual intercourse
Generalized weakness of both lower limbs (4/5 involving all joints noted at one examination)

treatments_received: Accident & Emergency Department treatment (Queen Mary Hospital)
Admission to surgical intensive care unit
Rehabilitation at MacLehose Medical Rehabilitation Centre (MMRC)
Psychiatric treatment / follow-up at Western Psychiatric Centre
Inpatient psychiatric admissions (Queen Mary Hospital psychiatric ward)
treatments_future: Further psychiatric treatment (private sector) as estimated by treating psychiatrists

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Developed phobia towards vehicles on the street and did not manage to go out alone; afraid of going out alone for a period
Problems adversely affected her family; forced to sell matrimonial home; husband quit his job to care for her

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Back pain during sexual intercourse and loss of sexual interest
Unable to walk for 5 minutes at one stage; required a walking stick for periods; limping
Unable to resume pre-injury work as a health care worker despite trying on four occasions; had to quit those jobs
